2. Line ~985 (head): `GetPropertyIdentifierLocation(item)` instead of `((PropertyDeclarationSyntax)item.DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0].GetSyntax()).Identifier.GetLocation()` - the old code used `[0]` directly which would throw IndexOutOfRangeException if `DeclaringSyntaxReferences` is empty (metadata types).
